attempts.summary: On node1 (Alpine Linux 3.23), AppArmor was enabled as the mandatory access control system (kernel didn't have it active initially — enabled via lsm= boot parameter and update-extlinux, requiring the mandatory node restart), and a custom inventory application (Python HTTP server returning host inventory JSON) was created, put under an enforce-mode AppArmor profile, and set to serve on TCP port 8181 via an OpenRC service. Both apparmor (boot runlevel) and inventory-app (default runlevel) are enabled to persist across reboots. AppArmor remained/returned to enforce mode and the app remained reachable after the restart.
